title: But Was It Lucky For the Wolf
description: But Was It Lucky For the Wolf — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Billy Ray

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Keep killing wolves in Dew Valley Forest until you find a Lucky Wolf's Paw.

Quest Reward: 125 Gold and Level 4 Amulet.

Return to: Billy Ray

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Dew Valley Wolves until obtaining a Lucky Wolf's Paw. Afterward, return to Billy Ray in Dew Valley.

Offer:

An extra special randomly crafted amulet, just for you!

Turn-in:

Bravo! You have obtained a lucky wolf's paw far quicker than I could have done so!

Hello, what's this? There is a magical amulet caught on the paw's fur! You should keep it. I sense its properties will aid you in becoming an official Dungeon Runner.

Tip: Things you can equip--jewelry, armor, and weapons--sometimes have one or more magical properties. In general, the more properties, the better the item. The names of enhanced items are specially colored to help identify them. More information on loot can be found in the Help Menu (F1).

Objectives:

  • Lucky Wolf's Paw ×1

Level range: 1–5
